definitions.explanation: A musical wind instrument, especially traditional Japanese flutes.
An instrument that makes a shrill sound when blown.

examples.japanese: {祭|まつ}りで{笛|ふえ}の{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえた。
examples.english: I heard the sound of flutes at the festival.

examples.japanese: {審判|しんぱん}が{笛|ふえ}を{吹|ふ}いた。
{横笛|よこぶえ}の{演奏|えんそう}を{習|なら}っている。
examples.english: I'm learning to play the transverse flute.

notes:
USAGE: {笛|ふえ} is a general term that includes both musical flutes and signal whistles.

TYPES OF FLUTES:
・{横笛|よこぶえ} - transverse flute (played sideways)
・{縦笛|たてぶえ} - recorder (played vertically)
・{尺八|しゃくはち} - shakuhachi (traditional bamboo flute)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{笛|ふえ}を{吹|ふ}く (to blow a flute/whistle)
・{笛|ふえ}の{音|おと/ね} (sound of a flute)
